name: Tide Range
description: A two-thumb range slider drawn as a strip of moving water, with bobbing buoys for thumbs and deeper water between them.

props.name: defaultValue
props.default: a quarter and three fifths of the way along

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called continuously while a buoy moves.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called when a drag or key press ends.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How the flags and the scale write values, e.g. { style: "unit", unit: "meter" }.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names for the two buoys.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the water. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the slider and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Slider.
